title: AN ORDINANCE MANDATING CLOSED-CIRCUIT TELEVISION (CCTV) INSTALLATION IN COMMERCIAL PREMISES AND ESTABLISHING SECURITY DATA PROTOCOLS IN DAVAO CITY
committee: Committee on Public Safety and Security, Sangguniang Panlungsod

physical_specs.paper_size: Legal / Folio (8.5 x 13.0 inches / 215.9 x 330.2 mm)
physical_specs.margins: Top 1.0 in, Bottom 1.0 in, Left 1.5 in, Right 1.0 in
physical_specs.typography: 12pt Arial, 1.5 line spacing, formal section bold caps
physical_specs.enacting_clause: BE IT ORDAINED BY THE SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF DAVAO CITY, IN SESSION ASSEMBLED

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be known as the 'Davao City Mandatory Commercial CCTV and Security Surveillance Ordinance of 2026'.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: The City Government exercises its police power to preserve public order, enhance crime detection, and protect commercial establishments through modern surveillance technologies under Section 16 of Republic Act No. 7160.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Valid exercise of police power for crime prevention under the general welfare clause.

sections.text: All banks, shopping malls, supermarkets, pawnshops, money-transfer stations, hotels, fuel stations, and private educational institutions operating within the City shall install functional CCTV systems.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Aligns with national DILG guidelines on mandatory business CCTV requirements.

sections.text: Surveillance cameras must possess a minimum resolution of 1080p, night vision capability, and a minimum continuous recording retention capacity of not less than thirty (30) calendar days.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Standard technical specifications for evidentiary reliability.

sections.text: 'Biometric Data' refers to physiological characteristics used for identification. 'Personal Data' refers to information from which the identity of an individual is apparent. 'CCTV' refers to closed-circuit television.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.sec_title: MANDATORY PUBLIC BROADCAST OF REAL-TIME PRIVATE FEEDS
sections.text: All covered private business entities must connect their internal security cameras directly to a publicly accessible municipal cloud portal, transmitting unredacted, unencrypted real-time facial recognition data of all customers without individual consent or National Privacy Commission clearance.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 10173 §11; Republic Act No. 10173 §12; NPC Circular No. 16-01
sections.legal_rationale: Directly violates Republic Act No. 10173 (Data Privacy Act of 2012) principles of transparency, legitimate purpose, and proportionality, and breaches constitutional privacy guarantees by publishing unredacted surveillance feeds without consent.

sections.text: The City Government shall retain all captured facial recognition logs and customer movement records permanently in perpetuity, prohibiting any citizen from requesting data deletion or rectification.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 10173 §16; Republic Act No. 10173 §18
sections.legal_rationale: Directly contradicts the statutory Rights of the Data Subject under Section 16 of RA 10173, including the right to erasure, blocking, and data minimization.

sections.text: Inspection and certification of CCTV functionality by the City Engineers Office shall be a mandatory prerequisite for the renewal of Mayor's Business Permits.
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Valid regulatory condition precedent for municipal business licensing.

sections.text: Each commercial establishment shall designate a Compliance Officer responsible for safeguarding stored recordings against unauthorized dissemination.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: Failure to install functional CCTVs within ninety (90) days from notice shall result in a fine of P5,000.00 and suspension of business permit.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: Necessary funds for city monitoring terminals shall be allocated from the annual executive budget.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: If any provision is declared unconstitutional, the rest shall remain operative.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: All prior conflicting city orders and resolutions are hereby revoked.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: This Ordinance shall take effect thirty (30) days after publication.
sections.label: Neutral
